proposals.title: Proposal to Disclose Direct and Indirect Lobbying Activities and Expenditures
proposals.proponent: Service Employees International Union Pension Plans Master Trust
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report disclosing Lilly's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association and model-legislation organization payments, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Amend the Bylaws to Require an Independent Board Chair
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the board chair, whenever possible, to be an independent director, phased in at the next CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Implement a Bonus Deferral Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Compensation Committee to allow withholding and adjusting part of senior executive bonuses based on short-term financial metrics during a deferral period.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal to Disclose Clawbacks on Executive Incentive Compensation Due to Misconduct
proposals.topic_summary: Requests annual disclosure of whether incentive compensation was clawed back from senior executives due to misconduct, including former senior executives.
proposals.evidence: The board recommends that you vote AGAINST this proposal.
